snippet.title: Palisade Gameplay Trailer | Historical Strategy RTS
snippet.description:
Wishlist Palisade and play the free demo on Steam.

Palisade is a compact historical territorial strategy game. Expand your realm, secure naval landings and supply routes, fortify strongholds with trade road networks, and divide and conquer with cavalry across roguelite campaign sagas and up to 8-player multiplayer.

Key Features:
• Fast-paced territorial expansion and defensive wall building
• Naval invasions, supply routes, and trade road logistics
• Roguelite campaign sagas with persistent legacies
• Up to 8-player online multiplayer and skirmish battles
• Deep strategic AI and dynamic battlefields
